Author: veyn
Name: Boss Mod
Description:
Boss Mod is a combat and raid utility plugin featuring encounter radar, auto-rotation, cooldown planning, and AI automation.

Features:
• Radar & Mechanics: Real-time arena mini-map displaying player and boss positions, upcoming AoEs, mechanic hints, and safe spot resolutions.
• Autorotation: Optimal rotation execution supporting slidecasting, oGCD weaving, action queuing, and smart targeting.
• Cooldown Planner: Timeline-based mitigation and cooldown planning customizable per encounter.
• AI: Movement automation to avoid AoEs and resolve encounter mechanics.
• Replay Tools: Encounter recording and analysis for review and module creation.
Punchline: Don't fail at raid mechanics anymore
